component.name: Brain
component.summary: Write and link notes in a folder you own

description.p: Brain is a Markdown notebook for GNOME. Your notes are ordinary .md files in a folder you choose — delete Brain and they are untouched, put the folder in git and you have history, open it in any other editor and it reads the same.

ul.li: An editor that styles Markdown as you write it, hiding the syntax characters everywhere except the block you are working in
[[Wikilinks]] with completion, backlinks, and renames that repoint every link that pointed at a note
Tags, inline and in frontmatter, nested and filterable
Attachments you drop or paste, with images shown in the note
Search by title or through the text of every note

description.p: No account, no sync, no plugins, and nothing written into a note that a text editor cannot read.
